metal_framework.geometry_basis: Shared oxygen in CIF bond table (identity symmetry only); M-O vectors use nearest periodic images, M-M separations use the same bridge images, and the metal-site shape uses bridge-connected unwrapped coordinates. M-M values are separations, not metal-metal bonds.

description: BICCUP crystallizes in the monoclinic crystal system with space group I 2/a. Reported CIF formula moiety: C80 H200 Dy12 Fe14 O104 6+,6(N1 O3 1-),30(H2 O1). From the CIF bond table, Dy1 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy2 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy3 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy4 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy5 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy6 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Fe1 (Fe) has 6 O neighbors; Fe2 (Fe) has 6 O neighbors; Fe3 (Fe) has 6 O neighbors; Fe4 (Fe) has 6 O neighbors; Fe5 (Fe) has 6 O neighbors; Fe6 (Fe) has 6 O neighbors; Fe7 (Fe) has 5 O neighbors; Fe8 (Fe) has 5 O neighbors; Dy7 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy8 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy9 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy10 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy11 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy12 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Fe9 (Fe) has 6 O neighbors; Fe10 (Fe) has 6 O neighbors; Fe11 (Fe) has 6 O neighbors; Fe12 (Fe) has 6 O neighbors; Fe13 (Fe) has 5 O neighbors; Fe14 (Fe) has 5 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 92 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a network with cycles with three-dimensional metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 2.935-4.138 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 91.48-138.82°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula [Dy12Fe14(HL)16(μ3-OH)20(μ2-OH)12(μ4-O)12(H2O)12]·(NO3)6·30H2O. Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 20 μ3-OH (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 12 μ2-OH (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 12 μ4-O (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 12 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 6 NO3 (explicit grouped unit in article formula).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.

candidate_structural_motifs.method: agglomerative weighted modularity; edge weight = shared oxygen count
candidate_structural_motifs.interpretation_limit: Algorithmic graph partition, not author-defined units or an assembly pathway. Check symmetry, disorder, bond completeness and article figures before interpreting motifs.
